name: Connections
summary:
Play Connections from New York Times Games. Group words that share a common thread. You can also track your stats and streaks. A new puzzle is released daily.

How to play
Find groups of four items that share something in common. Each group is assigned a color, which will be revealed as you solve. You have four chances to find the correct groups. Watch out for words that seem to belong to multiple categories. Each puzzle has exactly one solution.   

Share your results with friends on Quest, Instagram, Face
